answer_1.quote: OASIS leverages LLMs to generate high-quality docstrings for function-level code snippets, treating these docstrings as equivalent to queries.
answer_1.outputs: Generated docstrings (natural language descriptions of code)

answer_2.quote: For the NL2Code tasks, we employ Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) ... For the Code2Code retrieval tasks, ... the Mean Average Precision (MAP) is utilized as the metric for evaluation.

answer_3.quote: Finally, an LLM is used to determine, with the docstring as a query, whether the candidate code or the code of the positive pair better answers the query.
